messages:
pat: heads up: telemetry spike showing many 413s on embeds when customers batch ~800 tiny items. propose a graceful per-item fallback to a lower-dim variant (embed-small) instead of rejecting whole request.

devin: per-item fallback sounds ideal for UX, but runtime needs to know whether partial fallback is allowed for that tenant. Also need billing clarity: do we bill per-item with variant's unit rate?

riley: agree on billing per-item by actual variant used. add a header so clients can see what happened. suggestion: X-Redwood-Embed-Variant: embed-small|embed-pro, and X-Redwood-Embed-Est-Units stays.

sam: telemetry requirements: we need counts of items_fell_back, items_total, avg_unit_delta, and a sample_hash list (masked). Also add an offline-sample flag so we run a higher-dim compare on a subset. call metric 'embed.partial_fallback_rate' and 'embed.fallback_regression'.

ana: (cc @ana) for regression measurement: sample 0.25% of fallbacked items, compute cosine similarity vs original model (run async), store mean/95p per-route. No raw inputs persisted, only hashed ids and vectors. retention 60d.

devin: runtime implementation sketch:
```
for item in batch:
  preflight = estimate(item)
  if preflight.dims > tenant.dim_threshold:
    if tenant.allow_partial_fallback:
      route_item(item, 'embed-small')
      emit('fallback_decision', item_id=item.id, chosen='embed-small')
    else:
      mark_batch_reject()
      break
```
Keep batch splitting conservative.

pat: console UX wants a per-route toggle: "Partial embed fallback" with tooltip: "Routes oversize items to a lower-dim model when enabled. We sample quality and show regression metrics." Also show per-route: fallback_rate, median_unit_savings, and sample query ids (masked). Provide a link to a cost simulator that shows estimated monthly delta.

sam: edge-case: if embedding order matters for downstream (e.g., positional semantics), per-item fallback could be risky. Need a warning in console that fallback may affect relative similarity. Feature should be opt-in per-route.

riley: we should add a guard: if more than X% of a batch would fallback (say 40%), prefer whole-batch reject or fallback whole batch to preserve semantics. Add config tenant.partial_fallback_threshold.

ana: telemetry proto suggestion (flat fields):
```
preflight_est_units: int
preflight_dims: int
preflight_bytes: int
route_decision: string
fallback_flag: boolean
fallback_variant: string
sampled_for_regression: boolean
```
Log these in request logs and metrics.

devin: testing plan: unit tests for estimator, integration test for per-item routing + headers, e2e that verifies sampled regression computed async, and billing smoke test to confirm per-item invoice mapping. Also add load test to ensure routing overhead small.

pat: canary plan: enable partial fallback for 2% tenants for 48h, monitor embed.partial_fallback_rate, embed.fallback_regression, request_retry_rate, and cost_delta. Auto-roll back if regression_mean < 0.9 similarity or retry_rate increases > 15%.

canary-bot: created canary 'partial-embed-fallback-v1' sampling=2% tenants, feature=partial_embed_fallback, started at 1750004490. dashboards: eng.platform/embeds/partial-fallback-1750004490. watch metrics: [embed.partial_fallback_rate, embed.fallback_regression, api.retry_rate].

riley: small naming note: avoid using public header names that collide. prefer X-Redwood-Embed-Variant and X-Redwood-Embed-Est-Units. Also return X-Redwood-Embed-Fallback:true when any fallback occurred in batch.

sam: ops note: add a log event 'batch_split_attempt' with fields items_total and items_fell_back to aid debugging. Also emit a sampling event to kick async regression job with the hashed item id.

pat: filed ENGPLAT-1498 for the telemetry + console tile. owners: devin, riley. finance loop-in required: @ana to confirm pricing rules.

ana: will sync with finance. initial stance: bill per-item by model used and show a breakdown in billing UI. need a flag so customers can opt to force rejects instead.

devin: timeline: telemetry headers + logs this sprint, runtime per-item routing next sprint, console tile after metrics backfilled. canary live within 10 business days.

pat: thanks all. ping this thread when console mock is ready. short follow-ups only please. :thumbsup:
